verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly say Scrape returns page content as Markdown, with HTML as a separate option (docs-1, docs-20, probe-1). Crawl and async batch jobs also return Markdown (docs-2, docs-3), and documents can be converted to Markdown too (docs-8). missing for 10: documentation of how the Markdown is cleaned (boilerplate/nav removal, main-content extraction controls), independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
